sentences.text: No, the May 2014 RBI circular on foreclosure charges on floating rate term loans is not in force on 2026-11-23 because it was withdrawn/repealed with effect from 2026-01-01 and is no longer in force.

The 2014 circular itself is marked SUPERSEDED in the evidence, and it states that banks will not be permitted to charge foreclosure charges or pre-payment penalties on all floating rate term loans sanctioned to individual borrowers.
A later RBI pre-payment directions document also lists the May 7, 2014 circular in its repeal table as a circular on "Levy of Foreclosure Charges/Pre-payment Penalty on Floating Rate Term Loans."
